verdict.rationale: Blaxel sandboxes run code through shell-command process execution. Output comes back as batch or real-time streamed logs, and Dockerfile-based images can preinstall any languages, so multiple runtimes are achievable but only implied, not documented as built-in language kernels. Missing for 10: a documented first-class code interpreter for Python/JavaScript, rich result types (charts, images, structured outputs) beyond stdout logs, explicit named multi-runtime support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
